g.title: creative_studio_dogfood
g.text: SAME engine as the ad capstone, a SECOND profile via build_root_agent(profile); headless CLI → package + manifest.json.

g.title: cluster_shots
g.text: ParallelAgent("shots") — 3 static slots, concurrent · stills ONLY (no Veo)

g.title: planner
g.text: (reuses PR-4 scriptwriter as beat author — 4th sibling, lazy import)

g.title: state
g.text: subject · music_mood · shots[1..3]{ beat, prompt, narration_line }

g.title: packager
g.text: checks every expected path with os.path.exists (NOT a resource_link)
records verified:<bool> per artifact · stamps model + suite_version deterministically

g.title: manifest
g.text: the versioned data contract a downstream tool reads
artifacts_verified = AND of every verified flag

g.title: gotcha
g.text: Exit code IS the contract: 0 only if EVERY artifact verifies
No stubs, ever · empty plan never verifies (locked by unit tests)

g.title: consumer
g.text: reads ONLY manifest.json — never the agent's Python
